title: Cover Page and Product Image
training_guidance: This page serves as a visual reference for the types of mechanical power transmission products covered in the Bonfiglioli Technical Quality Handbook.
The handbook applies to gearboxes, planetary drives, shafts, housings, and related power transmission components.
Document code MTQ-000 dated 26.10.2010 1/1 establishes the handbook version control.
summary: This is the cover page of the Bonfiglioli Technical Quality Handbook (document MTQ-000, dated 26.10.2010). It displays the company logo and a photograph showing various gearbox and power transmission products including planetary gearboxes, shafts, and housings. The page establishes the scope of the handbook which covers quality standards for mechanical drive components.
